title: The Ghost Caravan
text: A caravan of the dead goes by on the road, camels and drivers and all, pale as moonlight and silent but for the bells. The lead driver turns his hollow face to you. He offers to carry you a way, for the price of a story. The dead are always hungry for stories.

options.label: Ride with the dead, and let the best talker pay the fare in a story.

outcomes.text: The dead love the story and carry you further than they meant to. Their cold stays in your bones.

options.label: Trade with their pale merchant, for goods the living no longer make.

outcomes.text: The goods are old and real, cold to the touch.

options.label: Stand aside, and let the dead pass in peace.

outcomes.text: As the last camel passes, its rider drops something. When you pick it up, it is cold and very old.
The last camel looks back at you. In its eyes you see your own road, longer than you thought.

options.label: The Gambler pays the fare in a story, mostly lies, and trusts the dead to enjoy it.

outcomes.text: The dead love a liar. The caravan carries you a long way in one night, and you wake rested.
